title: What Happens When AI Picks Only Five Stocks?
author: FinnPowa
selftext:
**What Happens When AI Picks Only Five Stocks?**

Most stock-screening platforms give you more information than you could possibly use.

Hundreds of stocks.

Thousands of metrics.

Dozens of rankings.

Endless charts.

FinnPowa asks a different question:



**What if the system had to narrow the market down to just five?**

[FinnPowa](http://app.finnpowa.com) continuously analyses real-time market and financial information and uses its quantitative model to rank equities before selecting a five-stock basket. The portfolio is then automatically equal-weighted

That creates an interesting setup for anyone who follows quantitative trading.

The system isn't asking you to manually pick from a huge list.

It is producing a defined portfolio.

Five names.

Equal capital allocation.

A repeatable process.

And the platform is designed to take those selections through to broker execution, with support for both paper and live trading accounts.

For researchers, the interesting part is the hypothesis:

Can systematic ranking and concentrated selection produce a useful portfolio?

For traders, the question becomes:

How does the basket behave when the market changes?

For engineers:

How well does the signal-to-execution pipeline work in practice?

Those are measurable questions.

And measurable questions are much more interesting than vague promises about "AI beating the market."

[FinnPowa](http://app.finnpowa.com) gives you a live environment in which to investigate the idea.
